integrity: All numerical assertions follow from explicitly enumerating the full finite transition function twice using separate C++17 algorithms, with saved complete code and outputs.
scientific_limitations: Exact exhaustive classification of a single 20-cell rectangular torus; no extension to other dimensions, historical priority guarantee, or external validation. The previously known 4-row fixed-state count is not claimed as new.
title: Seven temporal periods and a sharp twenty-one-step clock for Conway Life on the four-by-five torus
